## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 05.06.2026 - 25.06.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _ESGiles_, 25.06.2026, 1/5: "I have the paid Pro subscription and the app started to glitch and I lost all my info that I used for work. I even reach out to support but got no response. Very disappointed!"
            2. _Calebthomasg_, 25.06.2026, 1/5: "It’s great, until it decides to erase all your notes. Everyone is having this issue and they aren’t doing anything to fix it apparently. Nobody can get a hold of support and there’s no patches coming."
            3. _M3atyV3gan_, 21.06.2026, 5/5: "I’ve used this app for about 2 years now and within the last month and a half the app has gone bad. Every time I open the app it either crashes or “glitches” and anything I’ve typed or written has been erased. Not sure what happened because I loved this app so much…"
